articles.title: A SpaceX Rocket Crashed Into the Moon — and NASA Found the Hole!
articles.summary: A leftover SpaceX rocket slammed into the moon at 5,400 mph. NASA's spacecraft spotted the new crater — it's 60 feet wide!

articles.title: Teen Builds a Tongue-Controlled Wheelchair and Wins $10,000!
articles.summary: Holly Tang, a high school sophomore, won $10,000 for her invention: a wheelchair you can steer with your tongue and eye blinks!

articles.title: Scientists Made a Computer Memory Out of DNA — It Uses 100x Less Power!
articles.summary: Researchers at Penn State built a memory device using DNA and a special material. It uses 100 times less power than flash drives!
